parole.testo: Borrowed from Hunsrik Schmier. Cognate of English smear and German schmieren.

parole.significato: Streuselkuchen (a cake of German origin made of yeast dough covered with sweet crumb topping)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Hunsrik Kuche (“cake”), from Old High German kuohho. Doublet of quiche.
